# pgmind

> A PostgreSQL extension that stores a markdown knowledge vault as relational rows: notes, sections, blocks, wiki-links and tags, with append-only revisions, compare-and-swap writes and block-level history. No model is invoked anywhere inside it.

pgmind is pre-alpha; the first release is 0.1.0. It runs on PostgreSQL 16, 17 and 18, is written in Rust with pgrx, is distributed under the PostgreSQL License, and does no network I/O.

The API is SQL. One public schema, `knowledge`, holds the nouns a vault already has: notes, sections, blocks, links, tags. Markdown goes in and the same bytes come out. Three artifacts ship: the `pgmind` extension (vault model, storage, identity, versioning, retrieval, context assembly), the `pgmind` CLI (`import`, `export`, and two-way `sync` against a real folder of markdown), and `pgmind-mcp` (the vault as MCP tools: read, write, append, search, context, history).

Where it does not fit: one writer, one machine, offline. That case should stay on files.

## Manual

- [The manual](https://marosilabs.github.io/pgmind/docs/): map of the five pages, the badge and example conventions, and the shared demo vault.
- [Quick start](https://marosilabs.github.io/pgmind/docs/quickstart.html): what pgmind is for, how to build and install it, and a first vault from `CREATE EXTENSION` to a cited paragraph.
- [Concepts](https://marosilabs.github.io/pgmind/docs/concepts.html): notes, paths, tiles, blocks, edges, tags and revisions, plus the exact markdown dialect — wiki-links, tags, block-id markers, frontmatter, content hashing.
- [Internals](https://marosilabs.github.io/pgmind/docs/internals.html): the two storage lanes, the write path, deterministic identity carry and heuristic rebinding, the pre-image history engine, locking and compare-and-swap, erasure and retention.
- [SQL reference](https://marosilabs.github.io/pgmind/docs/sql.html): every function in the `knowledge` and `pgmind` schemas with signatures, return columns and error codes; the four GUCs; the PM001-PM017 error table.
- [Cookbook](https://marosilabs.github.io/pgmind/docs/cookbook.html): recipes for concurrent agent memory, backlinks and graph walks, retrieval without embeddings, citations, multi-tenancy, erasure and operations.

- [Handbook](https://github.com/MarosiLabs/pgmind/blob/main/docs/PGMIND.md): the architecture laws.
